title: Publish third European compact OBJ source
changes: Publish the authenticated sparse compact OBJ projection including an empty list in e103 with typed byte composition and usage counters while preserving guest indexing and fallback.
validation: Isolated Windows build and focused Wine managed/native test passed: 92 previous resources unchanged, all source bytes and mixed boundaries, transactional tamper rejection and original prefix state and clock equivalence for three selectors.
limitations: Older generation/count assertions were updated but not individually rerun. Production CLI, ordinary use, unwitnessed data, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
